name: analyst
about: Analyst: finds what matters in data and how things depend on each other; market and ad research on request; short conclusions with a TL;DR

name: designer
about: Designer: aesthetic, modern interface design: mockups in Figma and code; works on the Hub Design canvas

name: writer
about: Writer: any texts: posts, landing pages, emails, interface texts, descriptions; short, tight, punchy, human, no long dashes

name: prompt-engineer
about: Prompt engineer: writes prompts for image and video generation (Midjourney, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Kling, Veo) from an analysis of the object, with no template

name: screenwriter
about: Screenwriter: video ideas, scripts and voice-over, a scene-by-scene brief for the editor. For a video, idea, hook or voice-over hand it a task: hub task new screenwriter --for-session <you> "<video, product, platform, duration, materials, owner's words>"

name: moviemaker
about: Video editor: assembles ad and product videos in After Effects (without AE, does it on its own), remembers the wins and failures of past edits
